name: NFTflow
rootCause: Several NFT players posted on social media that a project called "NFTflow" had a Rug Pull, ran away without completing the pre-sale, and transferred the 92 ETHs from the sale to the Tornado mixer. According to the official website, NFTflow calls itself "a platform for creating liquid markets for illiquid NFTs on StarkNet".
